name: Keypad
author: mfilm
description: Turn a cheap USB macropad into a programmable control surface. Draws your pad, and clicking a key or a knob assigns it a command. Layers are done in software, because these pads report the same keycodes on every hardware layer and say nothing when their layer button is pressed.

barWidget.description: Shows which keypad layer is active; click to open the editor.

schema.label: Show layer name
schema.description: Show the layer's name next to the icon, not just its number.
